feature_title: RUM SDK O2 Global Rename & Version Bump

rationale.edition: Every changed path in changed_files.txt is under web/src/, web/, or tests/ui-testing/ — none are in enterprise-owned locations (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/). Frontend Monitoring (RUM) is a core OSS feature, and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) appear in the changed paths or symbols, so this is an open-source change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped: no tests-added label or skip comment was passed (trigger_comment.txt is empty), and the change is user-facing — it rewrites the install-code snippets and SDK version in the Frontend Monitoring (RUM) setup card, not docs/CI-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because web/src/components/ingestion/setupCard/content/rum.ts changes the generated install code a user sees and copies (global rename OO_RUM/OO_LOGS → O2_RUM/O2_LOGS, SDK version 0.3.4 → 0.4.3), and the same rename propagates to the RUM E2E fixtures and the rum-traffic helper, so existing RUM dataflow/onboarding specs must keep matching the new globals.
rationale.area: RUM — the entire change is about the Frontend Monitoring (RUM) setup card and its test fixtures; sibling RUM specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/RUM/ (actual_folder RUM in the CI matrix).
rationale.group: The RUM testfolder in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_cloud.json maps actual_folder RUM and already names rum-onboarding-snippets.spec.js (alongside the cdn/npm/page dataflow specs), so it is the natural shard; it is currently documentation-only with empty run_files, so the Engineer must re-add the spec to run_files.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff — the only playwright-tests path changed is tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/utils/rum-traffic.js (a shared utility, not a *.spec.js). The changed web/src/**/*.spec.ts files (FrontendRumConfig.spec.ts, rum.spec.ts) are Vitest unit tests and do not count as E2E coverage.
